Resolves #20278

The memory post (#20226) now says what it is: part 1 of 8 in the series *How an AI team remembers*, covering one agent's slice of a larger system. Three additions do it:
- a series line under the title;
- a lede whose last two sentences scope the post to one agent and say the later parts widen it to a team;
- a `## The series` section before the call to action, listing all eight parts. Unpublished parts carry no link, and the section points to the Brain's `learn/agentos` guides the parts draw on.

The `blog.json` nav name ends in "(part 1 of 8)".

Evidence: L1 (docs; the diff is the artifact) → L1 required. Residual: none.
